name: Aimono Jyushi
source: Vocalist of the visual kei band ArgoξOrchestra. He is a two-sided character whose on-stage personality is very different from his off-stage personality. He was bullied as a student, and has always treasured his stuffed pig Amanda, which he received from his grandmother at the time, as a friend. Although he can be a bit of a crybaby, he has continued to struggle with his past and has grown to the point where he can speak his true feelings openly.
